parameters.name: AccessRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the cloud service is accessed.

parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks of the cloud service.

parameters.name: HostRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cloud service.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: HostVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that is associated with the cloud service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn delete-route-service-in-cen --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --host 100.118.28.0/24 --host-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-vpc-id vpc-bp1t36rn9l53iwbsf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
